'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Peter Davis DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Davis]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet name Peter 'No Nickname' Davis. Coruscant Chancellor's Office / Senate package.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Peter Davis]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|My Lord, Is That Legal?]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
